payload.body: JUST IN - Pakistan deploys 8,000 troops, a squadron of fighter jets and Chinese HQ-9 air defence system to Saudi Arabia, under a mutual defence pact, with military and air force crew deployed during the Iran war reportedly having an "advisory and training role." @disclosetv
